rules.when: Importing or changing Flood APIs
requires: Host package.json
flood.json
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed @flood-md/react declarations
verify: Host type-check
Matching CLI doctor for package alignment

rules.when: Composing screens or forms
requires: Supported installed exports
User interaction requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: DESIGN.md
verify: Rendered narrow/wide screen
Intrinsic actions and responsive form parent
Close choice label and independent group spacing
Reuse shared atoms while preserving specialized native semantics
Selected role owners and their installed contracts recorded before JSX
Actual date/selection popup checked against the selected component
Container/grid/media geometry at the host's declared viewport and text targets
No invisible focusable content without reveal behavior

rules.when: Changing fields or submission
requires: Visible labels
Host validation and submission flow
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed Field/control contract
verify: Accessible names and descriptions
Native values, required and reset
Invalid focus and disabled/loading behavior

rules.when: Changing interactive controls
requires: Runnable screen
Installed control keyboard contract
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed component behavior and DESIGN.md
verify: Keyboard-only full interaction
Visible focus in every relevant state
Select commit/cancel if present

rules.when: Customizing visual roles
requires: Installed token manifest
Actual affected surfaces
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed token roles; source tokens.json when developing Flood
verify: Resolved scoped semantic values
Text and non-text contrast
No parallel raw palette

rules.when: Changing layout or type
requires: Actual composed screen
rules.sourceOfTruth: DESIGN.md and host content requirements
verify: 320px width
Root 24px and increased text spacing
No glyph shrink or unintended page overflow

rules.when: Reporting completion
requires: Host verification scripts
Task scope
rules.sourceOfTruth: Observed command and rendered behavior results
verify: Commands and actual results recorded
Manual checks distinguished
Untested behavior stated

rules.when: Installing or updating guidance
requires: Existing host instructions
User scope
rules.sourceOfTruth: Host files and version-matched guide set
verify: Existing files preserved
No linked destinations followed
No publication inferred from source version

rules.when: Composing or reviewing spacing, density, nested surfaces or moving previews
requires: Installed token manifest
Rendered host and actual wrapper tree
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed component recipe and host layout requirements
verify: Measure visible gaps and row pitch, including padding and minimum height
Check wrapping and enlarged text
Check fine/coarse pointers and nonoverlapping interactive targets
Preserve keyboard focus and label activation
Peer form grids sharing an outer frame use coherent tracks and gutters, or have an explicit contextual reason

rules.when: Building or reviewing Flood components, composites, website or host UI
requires: Matching installed exports and component contracts
Existing component anatomy and current composition
rules.sourceOfTruth: DESIGN.md and the Flood composition skill
verify: Existing semantic primitives remain present in the rendered composition
Missing reusable capabilities are implemented in a small primitive before the larger composite
No replacement markup or hidden anatomy used to bypass a primitive
Alignment checked within each row and in the real host

rules.when: Applying dark surfaces, type, control or icon roles
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed semantic roles and actual composited backgrounds
verify: Trace changed roles to their actual consumers
Distinguish decoration, necessary boundaries, selection and accent focus
Check explicit icon sizing, heading semantics, long text and enlarged root geometry

rules.when: Aligning nested surfaces or controls
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Rendered anatomy, insets, radii and spacing roles
verify: Measure both axes including line height and minimum height
Compare nested radius/inset geometry without overriding independent actions
Check shared siblings and nonoverlapping targets

rules.when: Demonstrating size or feedback transitions
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Component behavior distinguished from preview scene ownership
verify: Changing size does not resize the preview scene
Feedback does not move an unrelated sample
Production controls do not inherit unnecessary fixed demo space

rules.when: Connecting controlled values or native form data
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed control values, callbacks and native form contract
verify: Inspect actual FormData and field ownership
Exercise accepted/refused controlled updates and incomplete drafts
Defaults match representation; no defaultValue-as-update or invented save guarantee

rules.when: Resetting a form or changing value representation
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed controlled/uncontrolled, reset and precision contract
verify: Normal and prevented reset preserve documented ownership
Minute/second defaults match selected precision
Advisory messages remain valid; native errors and disabled/read-only retain distinct semantics

rules.when: Opening or nesting a modal or anchored layer
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed trigger, open-state, focus and dismissal contract
verify: One mounted trigger retains props/ref and name
Topmost Escape and host refusal behave correctly
Appropriate modal/nonmodal focus and scroll restoration

rules.when: Placing popups or viewport-edge drawers
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Actual anchor, viewport, scroll container and semantic surface
verify: Check used sides, viewport edges, resize, long content and RTL
No drawer gap caused by page scrollbar gutter
Header, footer and padding leave a useful body reading area at enlarged narrow sizes; fitting rectangles alone is insufficient
Popup remains distinguishable with no rail-covered or clipped essential content

rules.when: Choosing destinations, selection, panels or disclosure
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed navigation, selection and disclosure contract
verify: Native link behavior and current destination preserved
Selection, focus and expansion remain distinct
Long labels and final sidebar items remain usable in actual supported orientations

rules.when: Presenting records, file items or tables
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed semantic primitives and content relationships
verify: Caption, headers and named-value relationships preserved
Row actions remain independent named controls
File metadata/status/progress reuse their existing primitives

rules.when: Presenting long, missing or changing content
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Actual data surface and overflow ownership
verify: Empty/loading/error and absent optional slots exercised
Final item/cell action and full essential text remain accessible outside rails
Server/client locale, narrow/enlarged text and RTL checked

rules.when: Reporting operation state or progress
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Actual host operation and installed feedback primitive
verify: Pending/success/error/cancel/local state is truthful
Unknown progress never fabricates a percentage
Empty content explains its cause and appropriate next action

rules.when: Announcing status, alert or loading transitions
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed semantics and required urgency
verify: One announcement owner rather than duplicate live regions
Messages do not steal focus merely to announce
Audible behavior claimed only when tested with actual assistive technology

rules.when: Reviewing names, keyboard or focus through a task
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed component behavior and actual accessibility tree
verify: Name, role and state observed rather than inferred visually
Keyboard completion, reverse navigation, cancel and recovery
Pointer activation gives custom keyboard owners actual focus across browsers while preserving deliberate host callback focus moves
Accent focus survives selected/invalid/read-only combinations without layout shift

rules.when: Reviewing readability under alternate viewing conditions
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Actual text size/weight/background and applicable WCAG criteria
verify: Text contrast and supplementary APCA interpretation kept distinct
Necessary cues are not reclassified as decoration
Reflow, enlargement, relevant pointer/RTL/forced-color checks and limits reported

rules.when: Stabilizing components or declaring a composition complete
requires: Matching installed declarations and guide set
Runnable host and actual content/state requirements
rules.sourceOfTruth: Current revision, applicable contracts and observed outcomes
verify: Explicit applicable-check disposition for every affected component
Existing coverage distinguished from checks run for this revision
Failures, source/host ownership and remaining limits recorded

rules.when: Discovering or extending Flood knowledge
requires: Matching package/configuration/guide versions
Host instructions
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed catalog and selected canonical or customized material
verify: Read scope and version before selecting material
Finish selected instruction pages
Run growth and clean-consumer checks for source changes

rules.when: Introducing or editing visible interface copy and hierarchy
requires: User task and scope
Existing product vocabulary
rules.sourceOfTruth: Actual user decisions and current interface context
verify: Changed copy has a necessary role or is removed
Titles, subtitles and hints do not repeat obvious context
Accessible names, needed constraints and recovery remain available
Each supporting sentence serves a specific decision or recovery need in the current state, not a hypothetical future risk
No standing implementation/storage caption merely because the data has a retention limitation
Prototype provenance stays in README/test handoff unless it changes a current record/choice/action; no automatic permanent environment badge

rules.when: Writing state, export, storage or completion messages
requires: Actual operation and completed outcome
rules.sourceOfTruth: Host behavior and confirmed product facts
verify: No invented capabilities, expert verification or delivery claims
Error explains the applicable failure and supported recovery
Technical details appear only when they affect a user decision

rules.when: Adapting content from another product or reference
requires: Reference purpose
Host objects, actions and states
rules.sourceOfTruth: Host capability and user vocabulary
verify: Reference pattern is mapped to the host question it answers
Competitor workflows, promises and marketing language are not transplanted without matching behavior

rules.when: Composing or reviewing task titles, group legends, named fields and shared form tracks
requires: Installed component and token contracts
Task reading order and actual rendered host
rules.sourceOfTruth: Installed hierarchy recipes and host content requirements
verify: Task, group and field roles are distinguishable without redundant headings
Label is closer to its control than independent fields/groups
Related rows share measured control edges; width exceptions have a content reason
Dialog title/body inset is owned once; actions remain reachable at enlarged text
Calendar content remains readable inside viewport collision limits

rules.when: Composing record lists, detail views or several row metadata values
requires: Current recognition/comparison/action task
Installed record component contracts
Rendered sibling records with varied content
rules.sourceOfTruth: Task information needs and installed record contracts
verify: Field to decision and list/detail placement choices recorded outside UI
Identity and summary remain readable with long and missing metadata
Stable scan positions or real named comparison columns, not drifting pseudo-columns
List, details, first-use and filtered empty states reviewed separately

rules.when: Presenting category, lifecycle status, priority, timestamps or collection counts
requires: Actual field semantics and current user decision
rules.sourceOfTruth: Host data meanings and corresponding Flood primitive contract
verify: Category/state/urgency distinguished with names where needed, not color alone
Essential triage/comparison fields retained; optional attributes do not compete equally
Dates identify useful events with suitable precision; formatted equality is not event equality
Counts and supporting text add current value; necessary announcements remain

guideResolution: Match guide to source in manifest.files; use its target relative to the host project root.
